biography.plain_text: Michael Buxton is a Melbourne property developer who co-founded Becton and MAB Corporation. He began in property management and sales at his family's established firm, JR Buxton. After building Becton as joint managing director, he sold his stake in 1994 and founded MAB with his brother Andrew the following year.

long_biography.plain_text:
Michael Buxton approached contemporary art collecting by following selected artists throughout their careers. Working with curatorial advisers, he developed a collection focused on living Australian and New Zealand artists, buying through galleries or directly from artists rather than on the secondary market. This approach allowed him to assemble substantial groups of work by individual artists.

In 2014, Buxton gave his collection to the University of Melbourne. He and his wife, Janet, funded a purpose-built museum and provided financial support for its operation. Buxton Contemporary opened in 2018, bringing the collection into a university setting where exhibitions, teaching and public access formed part of its purpose.
